text: World of Tanks is a game developed by Wargaming, the Cyprus-based games company. Press reporting citing Bloomberg (GameSpot, 2016) stated founder and CEO Victor Kislyi controlled 64 percent of the business directly and also held his father's 25.5 percent stake.
short: World of Tanks is developed by Wargaming, controlled by founder Victor Kislyi.

source.name: Wargaming — Games (official site)
source.quote: Wargaming has developed over 15 titles, including the hit World of Tanks, across PC, mobile and console.

additionalSources.name: GameSpot (Wayback Machine copy): Gaming Has a New Billionaire
additionalSources.quote: Kislyi controls 64 percent of the business directly and also has his father's 25.5 percent stake.
